title: Headlight: dependency-aware predictive orchestration for Kubernetes multi-cluster federations
description: Headlight v1.0.0 SoftwareX release: an open-source experimental orchestration stack for predictive autoscaling and availability-aware replica placement across Kubernetes multi-cluster federations managed by Karmada. The release includes the predictive AI module, Actions Handler, Controlled Replica Propagation controller, reproducible experiment tooling, baseline controllers, workload profiles, validation gates, and documentation.
